method.claim: bar_flow reports the same volume as the archive's independently built hourly candle family, and never counts unsided volume as a side
method.oracle: POST /archive/study study=bar_flow bucketMs=3600000 over 2026-08-04T00:00Z..2026-08-05T00:00Z, compared bar by bar against POST /archive/query family=candle_1h over the same range; candle_1h is built from the venue's own OHLCV schema, bar_flow is folded from trade_minute_1m, so the two share no derivation step
